basic_info.description: Prime Cow Hollow development opportunity! 3029-3031 Laguna Street was originally designed as a duplex with two bedrooms and one bathroom for the top unit, and one bedroom and one bathroom for the lower unit. The property has since been stripped to the studs. Site permit approved to add two additional floors boasting 4,400 square feet total. Owner's suite will span over 3,000 square feet with four bedrooms and four bathroom across the upper three floors. The ground floor ADU will be a one bedroom and two bathroom apartment with a bonus room/office towards the back of the property and spanning roughly 1,100 square feet. The new development will also add a two car tandem garage. The property is being offered for sale with all architectural plans and the site permit.
